stem: 一家机构正在制定一套全面的反洗钱(AML)框架.以下哪项陈述最能描述反洗钱政策与程序之间的关系？

options.A: 政策是对特定流程的详细说明,程序则是总体框架.政策和程序都不是强制性的,不一定要知晓和遵守.
options.B: 政策是宽泛的指导方针.程序是针对具体流程的详细说明.只有程序是必须了解并遵守的.
options.C: 政策是针对特定流程的详细说明,程序则是总体框架.政策和程序都必须了解并遵守.
options.D: 政策规定了组织的原则,并影响程序的制定.程序是针对特定流程的详细说明.

stem_en: An organization is developing a comprehensive anti-money laundering (AML) framework. Which of the following statements best describes the relationship between AML policies and procedures?

options_en.A: Policies are detailed instructions for specific processes. Procedures are an overarching framework. Neither policies nor procedures are mandatory for knowledge and adherence.
options_en.B: Policies are broad guidelines. Procedures are detailed instructions for specific processes. Only procedures are mandatory for knowledge and adherence.
options_en.C: Policies are detailed instructions for specific processes. Procedures are an overarching framework. Both policies and procedures are mandatory for knowledge and adherence.
options_en.D: Policies set out the organization's principles and influence the development of procedures. Procedures are detailed instructions for specific processes.
